probe_summary.candidate: deterministic claim_id plus immutable idempotent effect and successor identities
tested_traces: crash_before_effect: Q1 restart converges to Q3 with one committed effect identity
effect_then_crash_before_successor: Q2 restart reuses exact-matching effect and converges to Q3 without duplicate

probe_summary.revision: Crash safety requires idempotency to be bound to immutable effect identity C,H, not inferred from claim presence or ambiguous reads. Existing deterministic effect paths are acceptable only after exact content readback matches claim_id and payload hash; mismatch or ambiguous transport fails closed.
probe_summary.tested_limit: Exactly-once semantics for non-idempotent external side effects lacking a native idempotency key plus independently readable receipt remain unproven. Same-claim/different-payload ABA reuse is the next unresolved child.
